campaign: Solace Skin Lab — October 2026 (Dark Luxury Autumn)
status: Draft — client review required before activation

monthlyStrategy.primaryGoal: Qualified calls, messages and booked consults; grow a warm retargeting audience for November/holidays.
monthlyStrategy.audienceFramework: Local El Paso adults near Cielo Vista Mall; broad targeting with creative-led delivery (Advantage+); men's creatives separate; 21+ for wine.

META-08 retargeting; keep META-02 on through Oct 31.

measurement: Men vs women cost per consult

Pause any ad with no messages/calls after 3 days at stable spend

ads.name: 2×1 Tuesdays + Wine — Glow Partner
ads.audience: Women 25–55, 21+, within 10 mi of Cielo Vista Mall; exclude recent 2×1 converters.
ads.primaryTextA: Two facials. A glass of wine. The friend who always says "next time." Every Tuesday at Solace Skin Lab is 2×1 facials — bring your glow partner and make it a real plan.
ads.primaryTextB: Skip the same old dinner plans. Tuesdays at Solace Skin Lab: 2×1 facials and a glass of wine with your favorite person. Cielo Vista Mall, El Paso.
ads.compliance: 21+ for wine imagery/messaging; confirm 2×1 terms before live.

ads.name: Luxury Product + FREE Facial · $64.99
ads.primaryTextA: Fall is when your skin needs better products — not more of them. Pick any luxury skincare product for $64.99 and your facial is on us.
ads.primaryTextB: No tricks, just a real treat: any luxury skincare product for $64.99 and your facial is free. We'll show you how to use it at home.

ads.name: Salmon DNA Tuesday · 2×1 $89.99
ads.audience: Women 30–60 interested in skincare/anti-aging; retarget Salmon DNA post engagers (Oct 8).
ads.primaryTextA: Today is all about our Salmon DNA line. 2×1 Salmon DNA facials for just $89.99 — bring a friend and try the regenerative treatment everyone's asking about.
ads.primaryTextB: Curious about Salmon DNA (PDRN)? Try it with a friend: 2×1 Salmon DNA facials for $89.99 this Tuesday at Solace Skin Lab.
ads.headlineB: Try Salmon DNA With a Friend

ads.name: Microneedling for Men — Acne Scars & Scalp
ads.audience: Men 25–55, El Paso metro (broad; creative-led targeting).
ads.primaryTextA: Acne doesn't always leave when you turn 30 — and the scars can stick around longer. Microneedling may help improve the look of acne scarring over a series of sessions. Honest consult, no judgment.
ads.primaryTextB: Thinning hair is something a lot of men think about but don't talk about. Scalp microneedling may help support a healthier-looking scalp. Book a private consult.
ads.compliance: No guarantees; avoid personal-attribute phrasing ('your acne').

ads.name: FREE DpSCAN Skin & Scalp Analysis
ads.primaryTextA: Your mirror shows the surface. Our DpSCAN goes deeper — a visual analysis of your skin, scalp and hair with recommendations based on what we actually see. It's free.
ads.primaryTextB: Not sure what your skin really needs? Get a free DpSCAN analysis at Solace Skin Lab and leave with a clear plan. No pushy upsell.
ads.compliance: Analysis is informational; no diagnosis claims.

ads.name: BOTOX® Cosmetic — Holiday Plan / First Time
ads.primaryTextA: Most first-timers tell us the same thing: "That was it?" A BOTOX® Cosmetic appointment is quick and guided by a real conversation. Let's talk it through first.
ads.primaryTextB: Holiday photos are closer than you think. BOTOX® Cosmetic and facial series work best with some lead time — book a consult and plan your glow now.
ads.compliance: Include Important Safety Information per Allergan guidelines; results vary; no before/after.

ads.name: Facial + LED · Face & Neck · $64.99
ads.primaryTextA: Our favorite pairing: a tailored facial finished with LED light therapy on face and neck. Add a luxury skincare product and it's $64.99 — facial included.
ads.primaryTextB: Red, blue, green... we have 7 LED lights and combining them changes what your skin gets. Find your light: facial + LED for $64.99.

ads.name: Retargeting — Last 2×1 Tuesday + Treat, Not Trick
ads.audience: Warm audience: page/IG engagers 60 days, video viewers, message senders; 21+.
ads.primaryTextA: Last chance this month: 2×1 facials and a glass of wine, just in time for Halloween weekend. After this Tuesday, you wait until November.
ads.primaryTextB: No tricks, just a treat: any luxury skincare product for $64.99 plus a free facial. Book before October ends.
ads.compliance: 21+ for wine; urgency must reflect real availability.
